newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Csopak steady after K&H Sec. downgrades.
newsitem.headline: Csopak steady after K&H Sec. downgrades.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian retailer Csopak opened steady on Monday, after K&H Securities downgraded the papers to 'hold' from 'buy' after a recent rally in its price.
Csopak opened unchanged at 3,100 forints and in the first half an hour of trading only one deal was concluded for it.
"One of our favourites, Csopak share price more than doubled in a few days," K&H Securities' analyst Robert Rethy said in a report earlier today.
"That made us to downgrade Csopak from 'buy' to 'hold' as the current price seems to reflect real value."
